basicDetails.schemeName: A Scheme to Provide Assistance for Building E-Market Facilities in Market Committees

children.text: Co-operative Market Committees shall be eligible under this scheme.
The committee must operate within Gujarat.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. Co-operative Market Committees shall be eligible under this scheme.
   1. The committee must operate within Gujarat.

children.text: ₹1,00,000/- (One Lakh Rupees) per eligible market committee.

schemeContent.benefits_md: - **Financial Assistance:** ₹1,00,000/- (One Lakh Rupees) per eligible market committee.
schemeContent.briefDescription: This scheme provides financial assistance to market committees in Gujarat to establish e-market facilities, aligning with the National Agriculture Market Policy for a unified national e-market.

children.text: "A Scheme to Provide Assistance for Building E-Market Facilities in Market Committees" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat, aims to support market committees to set up e-market facilities, enhancing transparency and efficiency in agricultural marketing across the state.
